book.title: Learning How to Learn
book.author: Barbara Oakley, Terrence Sejnowski and Alistair McConville

predict.question: Starting from one known cue, each node links to two new nodes. With two hops and no overlaps, how many nodes including the cue?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Learning How to Learn encourages connecting new material with what a learner already knows.
modelBoundary: One-link branches reach {A}; two-link branches {B}. Added outgoing links expose more descendants within two hops.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Reachability does not establish comprehension, recall, or useful associations.
